data.text: Checklist for 0.8.2 before the tag: 1,363 passed and 1 skipped of 1,364 on main (an earlier local run had one failure that did not reproduce; on CI test (22) of PR #11 failed with ENOTEMPTY in test/branch.test.ts's afterEach rmSync and passed on rerun — a teardown race, not the product); typecheck clean; agent-package --check clean; npm audit --omit=dev clean; npm pack --dry-run: 10 files, no .kadence/, 124.9 kB packed. Medians of nine on Node 25: --version 85 ms (76 at 0.8.1, same laptop, another day), prime 122, ready 119, task list 118, search 178 (162 at 0.8.1) — all under 200, search the closest. board --json 321 KB parses through a pipe. init on a fresh repo under script(1) shows Coda; through a pipe it prints the 0.8.1 message unchanged. Nothing under src/tui changed since v0.8.1, so no TUI pass by hand. Criterion 1 does not apply: a release changes no behaviour; 4 does not apply: the core was not touched. init --no-hooks refreshed AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md without creating .claude/settings.json. Left out of the commit for the owner: the 2026-10-04 DOC-41 revision that names Blume's author (14c99a1 removed the name on purpose) and kadence-flow.html.
